about.description: {{appName}} is a personal productivity app for notes, checklists and finances.

privacyPolicy.collect: When you create an account, we store your email address and display name. If you sign in with Google, we also store your Google profile photo. We store the notes, tasks, finance books and settings you create.
privacyPolicy.use: We use this only to run the app: to sign you in, keep your data and let you share it. We don't sell your data or use it for advertising.
privacyPolicy.storage: Everything is stored with Google Firebase (Authentication and Cloud Firestore) and is covered by Google's security and privacy practices.
privacyPolicy.sharing: When you share a note or task, the people you share it with see its content. Your name, email address and photo are visible to other signed-in users, so they can find you to share with you.
privacyPolicy.analytics: We use Google Analytics for Firebase to understand how the app is used, for example which pages are opened. It collects usage and device information, not the content of your notes or tasks.
privacyPolicy.contact: To get a copy of your data, or to delete your account and everything in it, email {{email}}.

termsOfService.paragraph1: By accessing {{appName}} you agree to use the application legally and responsibly.
termsOfService.paragraph2: The service is provided as is, without warranties, and we may suspend accounts for misuse or security issues.
termsOfService.paragraph3: We may change these terms at any time; continuing to use the app means you accept the changes.

hero.title: Just write it down.
hero.description: {{appName}} keeps your notes, checklists and money in one simple place, on your phone and your computer, and shares them with the people you choose.

features.title: Everything you need to remember, nothing you don't

notes.title: Notes that format themselves
notes.description: Write with headings, lists and bold text as you type. Every change is saved on its own.

tasks.title: Checklists that keep up
tasks.description: Add items with a tap or paste a whole list at once. Finished items move out of the way.

finances.title: Money, sorted
finances.description: Keep books for a month, a trip or a project, in any currency. Type a sum like 24/22*28,500,000 right into the amount, and check the balance against your real accounts.

analysis.title: See where your money goes
analysis.description: Charts of your cash flow and balance, spending by colour-coded category, and your savings rate, worked out on your device.

sharing.title: Share it your way
sharing.description: Give someone read-only or edit access to a note, list or book. Changes show up for everyone right away.

everywhere.title: Wherever you are
everywhere.description: Works in any browser and installs like an app that opens on the page you choose. Light or dark, in English or Bahasa Indonesia.

cta.description: Create an account in a minute and start your first note.
